MLP.label: Standard MLP (Baseline)
MLP.summary: Classic feed-forward tanh network with zero internal state. Reacts strictly to the current frame.
MLP.howItWorks: Best on calm and static courses (Easy/Medium) as an ultra-fast baseline (solves Easy in Gen 1 with 13 weights).
MLP.verdict: Knowledge-compression champion on Easy (38.5 pipes/param), but vulnerable on Insane/Extra Insane without phase memory.

DROSOPHILA_CONNECTOME.label: Drosophila Connectome (Fruit-Fly Flight Circuit)
DROSOPHILA_CONNECTOME.summary: Biological 4-module Drosophila melanogaster flight circuit: T4/T5 motion LTC detectors + Mushroom Body APL sparse lateral inhibition + Octopamine arousal gain + Giant Fiber direct escape reflex.
DROSOPHILA_CONNECTOME.howItWorks: Primary choice for extreme courses (Hard, Insane, Extra Insane). Ships with native WebGPU (archCode=9) and CUDA C++ kernels.
DROSOPHILA_CONNECTOME.verdict: Outperforms classic baselines on Insane by separating the rapid Giant Fiber reflex from sparse state representations.

DECOUPLED_FLY_CORTEX.label: Decoupled Fly-Cortex (Reasoning vs Knowledge Prototype)
DECOUPLED_FLY_CORTEX.summary: Separates a compact Executive Reasoning Core (LTC + Giant Fiber + System-1/2 surprise gate) from a 16-slot FlyHash APL Associative Skill Bank updated mid-flight via Dopamine plasticity.
DECOUPLED_FLY_CORTEX.howItWorks: Ideal for researching decoupled reasoning/memory architectures and real-time adaptation (16-ray compound-eye pixels + mid-flight gravity anomalies).
DECOUPLED_FLY_CORTEX.verdict: Demonstrates that a compact executive core adapts in sub-second time without recomputing an entire monolithic weight matrix.

HYBRID_MOE.label: Hybrid Mixture of Experts (4-Module Router)
HYBRID_MOE.summary: A single brain starting as a lean MLP core that progressively spawns up to 3 specialist experts (LTC Fly, MinGRU SSM, Ponder ACT) gated by a Softmax Router with FLOPs ROI rollback.
HYBRID_MOE.howItWorks: Best when environment difficulty is unknown upfront and you want the network to allocate the smallest effective expert set per FLOPs budget.
HYBRID_MOE.verdict: Keeps compute lean during calm phases and activates temporal experts only during moving pipes and wind gusts.

PONDER_ACT.label: Ponder ACT (System-1 / System-2 Adaptive Compute)
PONDER_ACT.summary: Weight-shared recurrent network with a learned Halting Gate triggered by prediction surprise: runs 1 fast step in calm flight (System-1) and up to K deep deliberation steps in danger (System-2).
PONDER_ACT.howItWorks: Ideal for studying Test-Time Compute allocation—spending extra reasoning loops only when physical surprise spikes.
PONDER_ACT.verdict: Saves ~65% FLOPs compared to fixed Looped Reasoner while retaining full decision depth through tight corridors.

SELECTIVE_SSM.label: Selective SSM / MinGRU (Mamba State-Space)
SELECTIVE_SSM.summary: Modern state-space cell (Mamba / MinGRU-inspired) with an input-dependent selective forget gate z_t. Cleanly flushes state after clearing a pipe while tracking oscillation phase.
SELECTIVE_SSM.howItWorks: Best for moving pipes and variable gusts needing clean, low-overhead sequential memory in full GPU Lockstep.
SELECTIVE_SSM.verdict: Most stable sequential GPU architecture with minimal parameter overhead (+2 weights per hidden neuron).

LTC_FLY.label: Liquid Time-Constant Network (Continuous ODE)
LTC_FLY.summary: Neural membrane ODE network with an input-adaptive time constant τ. Can infer bird and pipe velocity purely from positional history.
LTC_FLY.howItWorks: Best when sensor inputs are sparse (e.g. missing velocity sensors) or under smoothly varying physical regimes.
LTC_FLY.verdict: Foundation of the Drosophila Connectome optic lobe; strong continuous-time temporal dynamics.

RESIDUAL_SKIP.label: Residual Skip Connection
RESIDUAL_SKIP.summary: Adds a direct linear input→output shortcut bypassing hidden layers.
RESIDUAL_SKIP.howItWorks: Useful when combining a fast linear reflex with nonlinear corrections from deeper hidden layers.
RESIDUAL_SKIP.verdict: Accelerates early evolutionary signal propagation in deeper topologies (D2–D4).

NEUROCHEM_GATE.label: Neurochemical Gain Gate
NEUROCHEM_GATE.summary: Slow neuromodulator trace that dynamically scales the sensitivity (gain) of each hidden neuron.
NEUROCHEM_GATE.howItWorks: Ideal for testing arousal-gain adaptation under abrupt speed gusts and gravity changes.
NEUROCHEM_GATE.verdict: Adds arousal memory (+3 params/neuron) running in full GPU Lockstep.

SYNAPTIC_STP.label: Short-Term Synaptic Plasticity (Tsodyks-Markram)
SYNAPTIC_STP.summary: Models biophysical synaptic vesicle depletion and calcium facilitation in real time during flight.
SYNAPTIC_STP.howItWorks: Useful for contrasting biophysical short-term plasticity against FlyHash dopamine memory.
SYNAPTIC_STP.verdict: Automatically dampens repetitive firing while amplifying sudden stimulus transients.

LOOPED_REASONER.label: Fixed-Depth Looped Reasoner (Universal Transformer)
LOOPED_REASONER.summary: Executes a fixed count of K weight-tied recurrent refinement loops on every frame.
LOOPED_REASONER.howItWorks: Best for testing deep iterative refinement under tiny parameter budgets and benchmarking Ponder ACT.
LOOPED_REASONER.verdict: Allows a shallow layer (e.g. 4 neurons) to emulate multi-layer depth via fixed temporal iteration.

LATENT_ROLLOUT.label: Counterfactual Latent World-Model Rollout
LATENT_ROLLOUT.summary: Imagines two counterfactual latent futures (FLAP vs GLIDE) inside a single frame and picks the higher-value state V.
LATENT_ROLLOUT.howItWorks: Built for testing explicit single-frame counterfactual planning and internal world models.
LATENT_ROLLOUT.verdict: Predictive planning architecture comparing competing latent trajectories before deciding to flap.

CMA_HYBRID.summary: Adapts per-synapse mutation covariance scales and injects the all-time champion back into the search distribution.
CMA_HYBRID.empiricalStats: Fastest Gen-1 convergence (11.1 norm-ms for 1→4→1) and top efficiency under ≤100-parameter budgets.

DE.summary: Explores weight space using population vector differences: v = x_best + F·(x_r1 - x_r2).
DE.empiricalStats: Global sweet-spot winner across 26,700 trials (Pop 150, Sigma 0.35 → 33.5% perfect rate, mean 331 evals).

GA.summary: Classic genetic algorithm combining tournament selection, uniform crossover, and Gaussian weight mutation.
GA.empiricalStats: 100% solve rate on Easy and excels at recombining discrete traits across diverse subpopulations.

NATURAL_ES.summary: Estimates the natural gradient via antithetic perturbation pairs (+ε, -ε) with rank-based fitness shaping.
NATURAL_ES.empiricalStats: Strong stability on larger networks (>100p), requiring paired evaluations per step.

ADAM_ES.summary: Pairs the ES gradient estimator with Adam momentum (β1=0.9) and adaptive variance scaling (β2=0.99).
ADAM_ES.empiricalStats: Helpful on long, noisy sweeps paired with Shaped Fitness rewards.

CEM.summary: Refits a diagonal Gaussian mean and variance to the top 20% elite candidates every generation.
CEM.empiricalStats: Fast on simple tasks, but prone to premature variance collapse on Frontier courses.

PSO.summary: Each particle tracks its personal best (pBest) and steers with inertia toward the global swarm leader (gBest).
PSO.empiricalStats: Rich continuous exploration dynamics, though slower final convergence than DE and Neuro-CMA.

ADAPTIVE_ES.summary: Automatically expands or shrinks mutation step size σ to maintain a 20% mutation success ratio.
ADAPTIVE_ES.empiricalStats: Classic reference benchmark for self-adapting mutation step size.

FP16.summary: Half-precision GPU floats (2× smaller footprint with negligible loss)

INT8.summary: 8-bit integer quantization (256 discrete levels per weight)

INT4.summary: Empirical knowledge-density record: 9.62 pipes/bit (52 bits total)

VEL_VY.opticalDesc: T4/T5 self-motion optic flow + haltere vertical velocity gyroscope
VEL_VY.description: Vertical velocity normalized by terminal speed

PIPE_DX.opticalDesc: Retinal looming proximity from frontal ommatidia rays #6–11
PIPE_DX.description: Horizontal distance to trailing edge of Pipe #1

TOP_CLEAR.opticalDesc: Dorsal ommatidia bundle (#1–8) clearance below the upper gap lip
TOP_CLEAR.description: Signed vertical clearance below Pipe #1 top lip (y - gapTop)

BOT_CLEAR.opticalDesc: Ventral ommatidia bundle (#9–16) clearance above the lower gap lip
BOT_CLEAR.description: Signed vertical clearance above Pipe #1 bottom lip (gapBot - y)

PIPE_VY.opticalDesc: Reichardt T4/T5 edge-motion correlator between neighboring ommatidia
PIPE_VY.description: Vertical velocity of moving Pipe #1 gap (+down / -up, 0 when static)

NEXT_PIPE_DY.opticalDesc: Far-field optical dipole from rays threading Pipe #1 gap onto Pipe #2
NEXT_PIPE_DY.description: Vertical offset from Pipe #1 gap center to Pipe #2 gap center (+down / -up, 0 if unseen)

NEXT_TOP_CLEAR.opticalDesc: Far-field parallax of Pipe #2 upper lip visible through Pipe #1 aperture
NEXT_TOP_CLEAR.description: Signed vertical clearance from bird to Pipe #2 top lip (y - nextGapTop, 0 if unseen)

NEXT_BOT_CLEAR.opticalDesc: Far-field parallax of Pipe #2 lower lip visible through Pipe #1 aperture
NEXT_BOT_CLEAR.description: Signed vertical clearance from bird to Pipe #2 bottom lip (nextGapBot - y, 0 if unseen)

NEXT_PIPE_DX.opticalDesc: Far-field optical depth of rays intersecting Pipe #2
NEXT_PIPE_DX.description: Horizontal distance to trailing edge of Pipe #2 (1.0 if unseen)

NEXT_PIPE_VY.opticalDesc: Far-field vertical edge motion (T4/T5 velocity of Pipe #2)
NEXT_PIPE_VY.description: Vertical velocity of moving Pipe #2 gap (+down / -up, 0 when static or unseen)

PIPE_TTF.opticalDesc: Optical time-to-contact τ derived from Lamina L1/L2 contrast derivative ΔI(t)
PIPE_TTF.description: Wind-compensated Time-To-Pipe in frames (DX / tickSpeed normalized by 120f)

EXTRA_INSANE.description: Unproven Overdrive beyond deterministic ballistic guarantees: 96±24px gaps, ±34px fast moving pipes, ±48% gusts, 4.15 speed, 1.24x gravity — tests phase anticipation and real-time plasticity.

ECO.label: Efficient Perf/Watt

BALANCED.label: Balanced

PERFORMANCE.label: High Performance

BALANCED_SEEDLING.name: Balanced Seedling
BALANCED_SEEDLING.tagline: Starts at 50% width with zero-disruption growth and selective pruning
BALANCED_SEEDLING.hypothesis: Starts as a compact seedling (50% width). After 10 stagnant generations it spawns zero-initialized neurons (Zero-Disruption Init) to prevent catastrophic forgetting.
BALANCED_SEEDLING.idealFor: Universal baseline across most scenarios (best balance of FLOPs vs solve rate).

AGGRESSIVE_EXPLORER.name: Aggressive Explorer
AGGRESSIVE_EXPLORER.tagline: Early neurogenesis and low FLOPs penalty to break past hard bottlenecks
AGGRESSIVE_EXPLORER.hypothesis: Expands neural capacity after just 6 stagnant generations. Low FLOPs penalty (0.001) lets the network freely explore complex flight trajectories on hard tiers.
AGGRESSIVE_EXPLORER.idealFor: Extreme courses (Hard, Insane, Extra Insane) where compact seeds stall in local optima.

EXTREME_PRUNING.name: Extreme Pruning
EXTREME_PRUNING.tagline: Aggressive synaptic pruning, strong myelination, and strict FLOPs penalty
EXTREME_PRUNING.hypothesis: Prunes synapses below 0.12 and applies heavy myelination (0.50) to lock core pathways, forcing knowledge into the smallest viable parameter budget.
EXTREME_PRUNING.idealFor: Microcontroller targets (Cortex-M0, ESP32) and minimum information-capacity studies.

ADAPTIVE_MOE_ROLLBACK.name: Adaptive MoE + Rollback
ADAPTIVE_MOE_ROLLBACK.tagline: ROI-gated expert spawning with automatic rollback on stagnant experts
ADAPTIVE_MOE_ROLLBACK.hypothesis: Spawns a specialist MoE expert when fitness plateaus. If the module fails to lift fitness by at least 35% within 8 generations, the expansion rolls back automatically.
ADAPTIVE_MOE_ROLLBACK.idealFor: Hybrid MoE architectures and dynamic courses with moving pipes and wind gusts.
